title: Claims Desk Standard: Damaged and Wrong-Size FilterDirect Shipments
content:
**Standard.** For FilterDirect Filter Subscriptions:

1. A shipment reported damaged no later than 14 calendar days after delivery is credited in full by a damaged-shipment credit naming the shipment, and replacement filters ship with the next cycle.
2. A shipment in a size other than the one on the subscription, reported no later than 30 calendar days after delivery, is credited by a wrong-size credit, and the correct size is reshipped free where the grade provides a free reshipment.
3. A credit is posted only once per shipment and credit kind.

| Grade | Window to report damage | Window to report a wrong size shipped | Correct size reshipped free |
|---|---|---|---|
| FilterDirect Standard MERV 8 | 14 days | 30 days | Yes |
| FilterDirect Pleated MERV 11 | 14 days | 30 days | Yes |
| FilterDirect Allergen MERV 13 | 14 days | 30 days | Yes |
| FilterDirect Media Cabinet MERV 11 | 14 days | 30 days | Yes |
| FilterDirect Media Cabinet MERV 13 | 14 days | 30 days | Yes |
| FilterDirect Media Cabinet MERV 16 | 14 days | 30 days | Yes |

Both windows are the calendar days after delivery within which the problem must be reported, and the clock starts from the delivery of the shipment concerned. A report made on the last day of a window is within it.

### Decision table

| Problem reported | Reported within | Credit | What follows |
|---|---|---|---|
| Shipment damaged | 14 days after delivery | Damaged-shipment credit for the shipment in full, naming the shipment | Replacement filters ship with the next cycle |
| Size shipped differs from the size on the subscription | 30 days after delivery | Wrong-size credit | Correct size reshipped free (every grade) |

### Window boundaries (hypothetical delivery on 3 March)

| Report made on | Days after delivery | Damage window (14) | Wrong-size window (30) |
|---|---|---|---|
| 17 March | 14 | Within | Within |
| 18 March | 15 | Outside | Within |
| 2 April | 30 | Outside | Within |
| 3 April | 31 | Outside | Outside |

### Once per shipment and credit kind

Whether a credit has already been posted is read from the subscription's credit records: the credits naming the same shipment, by kind. A damaged-shipment credit already naming a shipment means no second damaged-shipment credit for that shipment; a wrong-size credit already naming a shipment means no second wrong-size credit for it. The limit is counted separately for each of the two credit kinds.
